resume.description: The existing resume in markdown format (any version, any source)

jd.description: Optional: target job description for targeted optimization

reviewReport.description: Optional: output from review skill for targeted fixes

instructions.description: Optional: specific user instructions (e.g. 'shorten to 1 page', 'highlight leadership')

preserveLayout.description: Optional: when true, the user has a designed PDF and wants the layout preserved. The skill must NOT emit a full markdown rewrite; instead 'markdown' becomes a compact before→after diff of only the changed fragments, plus a note. Use this to avoid destroying a custom PDF layout.

sourceTexts.description: Optional: original source materials for anti-hallucination reference

markdown.description: The optimized resume in markdown format. When preserveLayout is true, this is instead a compact before→after diff of only the changed fragments (not a full rewrite), with a note that the user applies edits to their existing PDF source.

strategy.description: Brief explanation of the optimization strategy used

suggestions.description: Suggestions for further improvement (e.g. 'use dig to add more quantified achievements')
